The site uses [Webamp](https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp) 2.3.1.
The site loads the player when a visitor opens Winamp. The icon comes from [Webamp](https://github.com/captbaritone/webamp/blob/master/packages/webamp-demo/images/icons/winamp2-32x32.png).
The package comes from https://registry.npmjs.org/webamp/-/webamp-2.3.1.tgz.
The file `built/webamp.bundle.min.js` supplies the bundled player and its default skin.
The file `webamp-LICENSE.txt` contains the upstream MIT license.

The game uses [html2canvas](https://github.com/niklasvh/html2canvas) 1.4.1.
The game loads this library when a visitor starts the game.
The library renders the visible page for pixel damage and fragments.
The package comes from https://registry.npmjs.org/html2canvas/-/html2canvas-1.4.1.tgz.
The file `html2canvas-LICENSE` contains the upstream MIT license.
